This document covers Karbon API endpoints and data formats. You can find additional developer resources at [Karbon Developer Center](https://developers.karbonhq.com/). **Please note the following:** - Karbon's APIs use the OData standard to help with resource searching. Use [OData's reference guide](https://www.odata.org/documentation/odata-version-2-0/uri-conventions/) to learn more about OData URI conventions. - OData's `$expand` option is only available where explicitly mentioned. - If an endpoint allows you to use multiple properties with the `$expand` option, you can assign a comma-separated list of the properties to the `$expand` option. - Wherever `$orderby` option is explicitly mentioned, you can also use allowed property name followed by space then `desc` keyword to receive the response in descending order. > ⚠️ The examples shown below are for **illustrative purposes only**. Attempting to call an API using the examples for request payload might result in unusual behaviour because the Karbon generated values for various entities' keys may differ from the values in your tenant. ## Credentials for accessing Karbon APIs You will need two credentials - an Authorization token and an AccessKey - to access Karbon APIs. If you don't already have these credentials, follow the steps below to receive them and access Karbon APIs: 1. Karbon Customers can enable API access and obtain the Authorization (`Bearer`) token and Access Key under **Settings -> Connected Apps -> API Applications -> `{Your API Application}`** in Karbon. 2. Assign the Authorization token to `Authorization` header and Karbon Tenant AccessKey to `AccessKey` header to send requests to Karbon APIs. API SERVER https://api.karbonhq.com \- The production API server SELECTED: https://api.karbonhq.com AUTHENTICATION No API key applied | | | --- | | HTTP Bearer
The Application ID for your API application, supplied by secure message when your Application is first registered
Send `Authorization` in `header` containing the word `Bearer` followed by a space and a Token String.

SET | | API Key (AccessKey)
The AccessKey for your API application, found inside the Settings > Connected Apps section in Karbon
Send `AccessKey` in `header`
SET | Billing List and view an Invoice and associated line items ## Creates a new Expense post/v3/Expenses Use the `POST` method on this endpoint to create an Expense and associate it with a WorkItem, Contact or Organization in your tenant. Expenses cannot be listed, updated or deleted through the API. [API Key (AccessKey) + 1 more](https://karbonhq.github.io/karbon-api-reference/#auth) Requires **all** of the following **1.** Token in **AccessKey header** **2.** Bearer Token in **Authorization header** REQUEST REQUEST BODY \*application/json Refer to the table below for more information on each field in the request body. EXAMPLESCHEMA A single Expense ``` { "Timeline": { "EntityType": "WorkItem", "EntityKey": "2m6pSFxRzcF2" }, "ExpenseDate": "2026-08-14T00:00:00Z", "Value": 240.5, "BillableValue": 240.5, "Description": "Courier fees for year-end documents" } ``` object Single line description A single Expense { Timeline\*: { The entity the Expense is recorded against EntityType:enum ➔ The type of entity this Expense will be linked to Allowed: WorkItem┃Contact┃Organization EntityKey:string A Karbon-generated value to indicate the entity } ExpenseDate\*: date-time The date the Expense was incurred Value\*: number The cost of the Expense. Cannot be negative. BillableValue\*: number The portion of the Expense that is billable to the client. Cannot be negative. Use 0 for an Expense that will not be billed on. Description\*: string A description of the Expense. Limited to 250 characters. } RESPONSE 201 400 401 404 429 500 Created EXAMPLE SCHEMA application/json A single Expense Copy { "ExpenseKey": "3nB7kQvXLmT", "Timeline": { "EntityType": "WorkItem", "EntityKey": "2m6pSFxRzcF2" }, "ExpenseDate": "2026-08-14T00:00:00Z", "Value": 240.5, "BillableValue": 240.5, "Description": "Courier fees for year-end documents" } Bad Request EXAMPLE SCHEMA application/json The error returned when the query option in a request is not allowed for by the API Copy { "error": { "code": "4002", "message": "Query option '
